  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "{{ing_01|Dry pieces of salt tursio}} are boned, cleaned [soaked in water, cooked] shredded fine and seasoned with {{ing_02|ground pepper}}, {{ing_03|lovage}}, {{ing_04|origany}}, {{ing_05|parsley}}, {{ing_06|coriander}}, {{ing_07|cumin}}, {{ing_08|rue seeds}} and {{ing_09|dry mint}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "Make fish balls out of this material and poach the same in {{ing_10|wine}}, {{ing_11|broth}} and {{ing_12|oil}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "When cooked, arrange them in a dish."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "Then make a sauce [utilizing the broth, the court bouillon in which the balls were cooked] season with {{ing_13|pepper}}, {{ing_14|lovage}}, {{ing_15|satury}}, {{ing_16|onions}} and {{ing_17|wine}} and {{ing_18|vinegar}}, also add {{ing_19|broth}} and {{ing_20|oil}} as needed."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "Bind with {{ing_21|roux}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "[Pour over the balls] sprinkle with {{ing_22|thyme}} and {{ing_23|ground pepper}}."
    }
  ],
